title: Proposition 10.3: unramified transformations preserve pullbacks
statement_scope: Let θ:T′→T be an unramified transformation of pregeometries. Suppose given a pullback square σ in Top(T) with structure sheaves (Y′,O_{Y′}), (X′,O_{X′}), (Y,O_Y), (X,O_X), such that the underlying geometric morphism f*:X→Y induces an effective epimorphism f*O_X→O_Y. Then the diagram σ′ obtained by composing the structure sheaves with θ is also a pullback square in Top(T′). Complete statement and proof retained.
